notes.title: GDPR, bug fixes and updated to the latest version of Unity
notes.notes: GDPR is upon us and it's not clear what is and isn't allowed in terms of analytics. Turns out there's some deep embedded stuff turned on by default in some of the tools I used to make Promethium so I went through it all turning them off. While there I took the opportunity to update to the latest version of Unity and fix bugs. The end result is a faster version of the game so far!
